scope: Skip both derivative-noise octaves only when effective asteroid deformation amplitude is exactly zero; retain all other deformation and rendering behavior.
implementation: Initialize nv=vec4(0); evaluate fbmGrad(domain) only if amp!=0. Original dir/R position reconstruction, normal perturbation/normalization, all nonzero amplitudes, LOD weights, spin and optical effects unchanged. No new resources.

method.hardware: AMD Radeon Graphics / ANGLE D3D11, native Chrome155, 1280x720 DPR1, real Yandex S3 assets, Vite dev server
method.frozen: Stop engine after final frame; clone actual submitted instance matrices, world transforms and nontexture uniforms; preserve uploaded texture references and geometry attributes. Render Near/L0 separately to RGBA32F with depth. Compare production chunk to original AsteroidShape.ts extracted from669e0028; compare both float values and Uint32 component bits.
method.timing: Six warmups and32 native elapsed queries per variant; baseline and production repeated. Comparison covers every raw HDR component; draw costs are not total frame performance.
method.motion: 64 actual engine frames translating2 world units (4000km) and rotating360deg. Query each RenderPass draw, tag its frame index, sum elapsed queries per category per frame. Disjoint timings fail the run; metadata and samples must have equal lengths.
method.limitations: Motion profiling has per-query overhead and no paired original motion run. It identifies remaining cost rather than establishing motion speedup. CPU zero-detail counts are diagnostics, not exact per-vertex shader invocation counts.

conclusions.remaining: Billboard L1 draws dominate the measured motion path after this fix. Audit item16 remains open; investigate their submitted instances, coverage and fragment cost next.

minor.finding: The absolute1e-6 tolerance floor would allow an incorrect zero-amplitude shortcut returning raw position at radius scale1e-9; current production correctly retains dir*R.
minor.resolution: Addressed. Zero-amplitude position tolerance is now relative to the largest component of the reference position vector, without an absolute floor. A zero vector must match exactly. Nonzero amplitude and normal tolerances are unchanged.
minor.validation: Temporary mutation in the test shader (if aAmplitude==0, assign raw position after deformAsteroid) fails at vertex8: error4.272388432280199e-11 exceeds tolerance6.620612803646952e-19. Mutation removed; native and SwiftShader probes pass with zero position/normal errors. Typecheck, lint and full native browser suite rerun after this test-only correction.

finalReview.evidenceVerifiedByReviewer: All25 pre-review provenance hashes match; all16 timing batches contain32 samples and correct medians; all4 frozen comparisons report zero numeric and bit differences. Motion report does not claim unpaired speedup.
finalReview.postReviewChange: Only regression assertion, archived evidence and audit documentation changed after review. No second review; production unchanged. All findings addressed under the user's standing instruction to fix every finding.
